snippet.title: Bjergsen Stream
snippet.description:
Hello 
Welcome to Bjergsen VODs Channel. In my channel you can find best replays solo queue of Bjergsen and some league of legends events like LCS, MSI & Worlds.  I hope you will like the contents and maybe learn something new on League of Legends.
